# Afteroids Vision

> Founder-led YouTube video editing and motion graphics studio for creators and brands. Cinematic long-form edits, first cut in 48 hours, revisions until it's right. Free sample edit available.

## Services

- [Long-Form YouTube Editing](https://afteroidsvision.site/services/youtube-video-editing): Cinematic long-form YouTube editing with pacing that keeps viewers watching, motion graphics, color and sound. First cut in 48 hours. Get a free sample edit.
- [Motion Graphics](https://afteroidsvision.site/services/motion-graphics): Custom motion graphics and visual effects for YouTube videos, brand films and launches: moving type, logo stings, explainers and UI motion. Get a free sample.
- [Short-Form Video Editing](https://afteroidsvision.site/services/short-form-video-editing): Short-form video editing for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and TikTok: hook-first edits, dynamic captions and sound design. First cut in 48 hours.
- [Channel Management](https://afteroidsvision.site/services/youtube-channel-management): Full-service YouTube channel management: strategy, editing, thumbnails, titles, publishing and analytics, run by a dedicated channel manager. You record; we run it.

## Plans

- [Long videos: Explore](https://afteroidsvision.site/plans/long-form-explore/): Try us on one video. Creators and brands who want to see the full quality of our work before committing to more.
- [Long videos: Trending](https://afteroidsvision.site/plans/long-form-trending/): A steady rhythm of videos, made with one team. Channels that post regularly and want the same editor on every video.
- [Long videos: Viral](https://afteroidsvision.site/plans/long-form-viral/): Our fullest plan, for channels ready to go all in. Creators and brands with a lot to publish and a goal to grow.
- [Short videos: Explore](https://afteroidsvision.site/plans/short-form-explore/): Try us on one short video. Creators who want to see how we handle Reels, Shorts and TikTok.
- [Short videos: Trending](https://afteroidsvision.site/plans/short-form-trending/): A steady stream of short videos. Channels that post short videos often and want a fast turnaround.
- [Short videos: Viral](https://afteroidsvision.site/plans/short-form-viral/): Our fullest short-video plan. Creators who want to publish short videos every day.
- [Channel management: Starter](https://afteroidsvision.site/plans/channel-starter/): We handle the day-to-day of your channel. Creators who have the videos but not the time to run the channel.
- [Channel management: Pro](https://afteroidsvision.site/plans/channel-pro/): The day-to-day, plus a plan for growth. Channels that want someone to think about what to do next, not only keep things running.
- [Channel management: Done for you](https://afteroidsvision.site/plans/channel-done-for-you/): We run the channel and make the videos too. Brands and founders who want a working channel without managing the work.
